access.admission: A device or private runner forwards a local port to the cache host listener under its own rds identity. The cache host agent admits that identity and allows only the cache listener as its TCP target. Host, ticket, port and admitted identities live in the private estate.

integrity: The cache returns upstream bytes unchanged and commits an object only after a complete download. Clients keep their own digest and signature checks.

routes.objects: Distribution components and rustup releases; channel manifests are revalidated.
Flutter SDK, engine and Dart SDK archives and the Flutter Maven repository; release indexes and Maven metadata are revalidated.

clients.limits: Gradle refuses plain-HTTP Maven repositories without an explicit opt-in, so Android engine artifacts need TLS in front of the forwarded port. Pub packages are a later increment.

routes.objects: CPython release archives of dated release tags.
Gradle distributions and their checksum files.

clients.limits: Keep distributionSha256Sum. Whether the wrapper accepts a plain-HTTP distributionUrl is not verified.

routes.objects: Go release archives and their checksum files.

clients.limits: GOTOOLCHAIN downloads go through the Go module proxy, a later increment.

routes.objects: Chrome, ChromeDriver and headless shell archives of exact Chrome for Testing versions.

clients.limits: Version indexes on googlechromelabs.github.io are not proxied; resolve the version upstream or from a pinned lock.

routes.objects: Sparse index files of crates.io; they are revalidated. The cache answers config.json itself and points crate downloads at the crates route of the base address the client used.

clients.limits: Set through cargo --config or a Cargo configuration file: Cargo reads source replacement from no environment variable. Index changes reach clients after the revalidation age.

routes.objects: Crate archives of exact published versions; Cargo checks each one against the checksum in its index entry.

clients.tool: cargo, through the index configuration the cache generates
clients.limits: No client setting: the config.json of the crates-index route carries this download template.
